items.title: Improving verifiability in AI development
items.summary: We’ve contributed to a multi-stakeholder report by 58 co-authors at 30 organizations, including the Centre for the Future of Intelligence, Mila, Schwartz Reisman Institute for Technology and Society, Center for Advanced Study in the Behavioral Sciences, and Center for Security and Emerging Technologies. This report describes 10 mechanisms to improve the verifiability of claims made about AI systems. Developers can us
items.summaryZh: OpenAI参与了一份由30家机构、58位共同作者合作编写的多方报告，旨在探讨如何提高AI系统相关声明的可验证性。报告提出了10种机制，帮助开发者证明AI系统的安全、隐私等特性，并供政策制定者和公众进行评估。

aiReview.reasonZh: 多方合作发布了提高AI系统声明可验证性的报告，对AI治理与安全合规具有促进作用。
